name: cmd_denoise_settings
description: Denoise Settings (command `denoise.settings`). Params: {auto?: bool, cacheGb?: 1..10000, threads?: 1..64 | null, runOn?: auto | gpu | cpu} → the settings — `auto`: make the picture of the photos being looked at that have a Denoise amount; `cacheGb`: how much the cached pictures may take; `threads`: most tiles run at once; `runOn`: where the model runs — `auto` (the default) the graphics card where it is faster than the processor (both timed on this computer when the card is set up), `gpu` the card whenever it can run the model, `cpu` the processor. Setting `runOn` also lets the card be tried again after a set-up that failed or closed LightCraft.
